conventions.ingredient_count_band: Counted ingredients exclude optional items, salt, black pepper, water, and cooking oils: <=8 -> 0, 9-14 -> 1, 15+ -> 2 (D-03 rubric; corrected at freeze-r2 from the non-rubric <=12 / 13-16 / 17+ band, Vale r1).
conventions.pantry_familiarity: Kept 0; specialty-store items score once under specialty_burden (no double counting). Cultural unfamiliarity adds no points.

rationale: The scallop sear is a precision technique (crust without overcooking, pulled at 120 to 125 F) and the brown butter needs watching (technique 2, attention 2). Purée, brown butter, scallops, and salad are 4 made components (2). Saucepan, blender, two skillets, and a salad bowl run in parallel (coordination 1). Score 8 is involved; the technique floor also applies. Complexity: a short list of 7 counted items, but dry-packed scallops are a fishmonger or quality-counter item (specialty 1) and there are 4 components (breadth 1). Score 2 is standard, matching WAVE.
